_comment: Reviewed field aliases for the search data files (#158, owner decision Q3; D6, D6a). A field is a name plus a zip: each entry merges the complex names listed in `aliases` (in search_data.norm_name form) at that zip into one field called `name`, shown as `label`. Aliases apply only at their zip. search_data.py validates every entry; a bad one is left out, reported, and fails `python archive.py --search-data --check`. Same-zip candidates (counted after these aliases) are listed in the build report and are never merged automatically. #169: each entry's evidence states its shared start times on the fixture and on main; an entry with no game at its zip is stale, an error; two of its names at one start time on one venue key is a clash: an error on the fixture build, report-only on live builds (owner decision Q11), unless the matchID pair is listed in the optional acceptedClashes, which must still be such a clash.
